feed.title: 3 Bitcoin Core security advisories for easily discoverable vulnerabilities

entry.title: 3 Bitcoin Core security advisories for easily discoverable vulnerabilities
entry.summary:
Several new releases have been made available to address two medium severity and one low severity security vulnerabilities in the Bitcoin Core software. These patches are accessible across all previous major versions, with specific release notes for [32.1](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/27/release-32.1/), [31.2](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/release-31.2/), [30.4](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/release-30.4/), and [29.5](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/release-29.5/). Each of these releases addresses vulnerabilities that were recently identified and classified based on their discoverability and potential impact.
Comprehensive information about each vulnerability has been published in dedicated security advisories: [TCP Out-of-Memory Disclosure](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/disclose-tcp-oom/), [Fpausesend Out-of-Memory Disclosure](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/disclose-fpausesend-oom/), and [Undo Overflow Disclosure](https://bitcoincore.org/en/2026/10/28/disclose-undo-overflow/). These advisories are part of an accelerated disclosure process, which is specifically designed for vulnerabilities that are easily discoverable, ensuring a swift response and patch deployment.
Coinciding with the release of version 32.1, three additional vulnerabilities were pre-announced. These issues are distinct from those addressed in the latest batch of patches. Details regarding these separately managed vulnerabilities will be disclosed in accordance with the regular publication schedule, with further information expected to be released within two weeks.
For ongoing updates on security policies, historical disclosures, and details of past vulnerabilities, users can consult the official [Bitcoin Core Security Advisories page](https://bitcoincore.org/en/security-advisories/). This resource provides transparency and guidance for maintaining the security of Bitcoin Core installations.
